name: rushing/laravel-versioning
description: Record-agnostic versioning seams for Laravel — snapshot AND migration. Snapshot/restore: the Versionable contract+trait (immutable named snapshot + HEAD pin + restore), an immutable Version model, and a VersionStore. Migration-across-versions: the Migrator port (migrate a payload version-to-version), the MigrationOutcome value type (current/migrated/pending/failed, original-preserved, shouldWriteBack), and the reconcile-on-read / eager-drain concerns — the contract only; a concrete engine (e.g. schemastud/laravel-data-schemas' MigrationLadder) is bound to the port by an engine-tier adapter. Any schema-driven record opts into either seam; the app owns the tenant migration.
